title: Vertical app update — what's new in five screens (9:16)

source.author: @SebastianRoehl
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the HabitKit update reel; structure and pacing follow it. Brand, copy and every app screen are ours and fictional; the original's iCloud wording is replaced with a generic cloud backup.

scenes: habit grid assembles tile by tile, What's new in + wordmark
grid scatters around a new-habit form, segmented header slides Yes/No → Count → Measure
decimals: a gauge counts up to 7.5 km, turns into a check, colour tiles flood the frame
Done for today? completed rows collapse out of the list
vertical whip to cloud backup: backing up, backed up, backup saved
new phone: welcome back, restore, restoring, restored, squares travel along an arc
tiles fly home into the grid, wordmark and typed tagline
